annotations.title: Compare UK Mortgage Lenders Side by Side

description: Compare two to six named UK mortgage lenders side by side across their published underwriting criteria, and flag the topics where they differ. Answers questions such as "how does Halifax compare with NatWest on contractor income and retained profit". Sourced by Fox Davidson, whole of market UK mortgage brokers authorised and regulated by the FCA (FRN 1056214).

lenders.description: Lender names to compare, two to six. Partial names work, for example "halifax", "natwest".

topics.description: Optional. Topics to compare on. Defaults to every topic where the named lenders appear.
